name: Bangladesh Bank — Scheduled Banks Statistics (Rajshahi Division extract)
notes: No licence stated. bb.org.bd publishes no public, filterable scheduled-bank branch list (no branch names/addresses/routing numbers; the routing-number URL is blocked by the site's WAF). Only aggregate statistics are available: division branch counts (Table-3.16, image), district deposits/advances (Table-1) and thana deposit accounts/amounts (Table-33). The 8.5 MB PDF is not committed; fetch.py re-downloads it and needs poppler's pdftotext to parse it.
